items.title: Joe Muranyi interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: Matter of fact I told Benny Goodman too. You’re one of the guys responsible for me.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah, yeah. There was a skinny little red-haired girl, she might have had freckles even, she was singing and she had a violin you know. And it came her turn, and in the 30s it was [scats]. Benny Goodman made a record of it, it was a pop tune [scats].
